text: Ethnobotanicals: The plant medicines in this protocol are iboga (an African root bark) and psilocybin mushrooms. Both are illegal in many jurisdictions and carry risks, and iboga's are the serious ones, since it can be dangerous for your heart and nervous system. So never combine Iboga with most medications (especially heart & psych meds), and if you take any, check it against my full iboga guide here first. The iboga microdosing protocol is here.

question_text.Q4: What does each word act on, or mean here?
